comparisons.comparison: Both Qualcomm and Intel disclose specific drivers for their respective segment revenue changes in fiscal 2024, focusing on product volume and demand shifts. Qualcomm attributes its QTL revenue increase to estimated sales of 3G/4G/5G-based multimode products, whereas Intel attributes its CCG revenue increase to higher notebook volume, partially offset by lower desktop revenue due to demand decreases. Both disclosures highlight the interplay between specific product categories (multimode chips vs. notebooks/desktops) and end-market demand as key financial drivers.

CCG revenue increased 4% from 2023 primarily due to higher notebook volume compared to 2023 and was partially offset by lower other CCG revenue, which decreased from 2023 due to the exit of legacy businesses, and lower desktop revenue, which decreased on lower demand compared to 2023.
